# Settings in hosts/homelab/kernel.nix whose silent loss would cost a rebuild, a
# capability, or a hardening. `ignoreConfigErrors` makes a renamed symbol or a
# rewritten value invisible, so the build greps the generated .config for these
# before it spends two hours. Literal .config text, one line each.
CONFIG_NR_CPUS=8
CONFIG_HZ=250
CONFIG_PREEMPT_LAZY=y
CONFIG_PREEMPT_DYNAMIC=y
CONFIG_SCHED_SMT=y
CONFIG_SCHED_MC=y
CONFIG_X86_ACPI_CPUFREQ=y
CONFIG_CPU_IDLE_GOV_TEO=y
# CONFIG_CPU_IDLE_GOV_MENU is not set
# CONFIG_INTEL_IDLE is not set
CONFIG_BPF_JIT_ALWAYS_ON=y
CONFIG_HARDENED_USERCOPY=y
CONFIG_INIT_ON_ALLOC_DEFAULT_ON=y
CONFIG_SLAB_FREELIST_HARDENED=y
CONFIG_STRICT_KERNEL_RWX=y
CONFIG_STRICT_MODULE_RWX=y
CONFIG_RANDOMIZE_BASE=y
CONFIG_LIST_HARDENED=y
# The CPU-mitigation and hardening set kernel.nix names, so a "minimal" trim
# cannot drop the barrier between user space and the kernel without failing the
# build. The rest of the MITIGATION_* family applies to Intel parts this box
# does not have; these six are the ones that exist on fam15h.
CONFIG_MITIGATION_RETPOLINE=y
CONFIG_MITIGATION_SPECTRE_V1=y
CONFIG_MITIGATION_SPECTRE_V2=y
CONFIG_MITIGATION_RETBLEED=y
CONFIG_MITIGATION_UNRET_ENTRY=y
CONFIG_MITIGATION_SSB=y
CONFIG_FORTIFY_SOURCE=y
CONFIG_STACKPROTECTOR_STRONG=y
CONFIG_VMAP_STACK=y
CONFIG_SHUFFLE_PAGE_ALLOCATOR=y
CONFIG_BUG_ON_DATA_CORRUPTION=y
CONFIG_SECURITY_LANDLOCK=y
CONFIG_SECURITY_YAMA=y
CONFIG_LSM="landlock,lockdown,yama,loadpin,safesetid,selinux,smack,tomoyo,apparmor,ipe,bpf"
# CONFIG_DEBUG_LIST is not set
# CONFIG_KFENCE is not set
# CONFIG_KALLSYMS_ALL is not set
# CONFIG_MEMORY_HOTPLUG is not set
# CONFIG_DAMON is not set
# CONFIG_X86_USER_SHADOW_STACK is not set
# CONFIG_X86_KERNEL_IBT is not set
CONFIG_MODULE_COMPRESS_ZSTD=y
# CONFIG_MODULE_COMPRESS_XZ is not set
CONFIG_EXT4_FS=y
CONFIG_VFAT_FS=y
CONFIG_NTFS3_FS=m
CONFIG_FUSE_FS=m
CONFIG_DRM_RADEON=m
# CONFIG_DRM_AMDGPU is not set
CONFIG_R8169=m
# CONFIG_MEDIA_SUPPORT is not set
# CONFIG_SND_SOC is not set
# CONFIG_STAGING is not set
# CONFIG_IIO is not set
# CONFIG_HYPERVISOR_GUEST is not set
# CONFIG_NFS_FS is not set
# CONFIG_9P_FS is not set
CONFIG_CFG80211=m
CONFIG_MAC80211=m
CONFIG_BT=m
CONFIG_BT_HCIBTUSB=m
CONFIG_BT_HCIBTSDIO=m
CONFIG_BT_HCIUART=m
# CONFIG_BT_DEBUGFS is not set
CONFIG_RTL8XXXU=m
CONFIG_RTW88=m
CONFIG_MT76_USB=m
CONFIG_IWLMVM=m
CONFIG_ATH9K=m
CONFIG_HP_WMI=m
CONFIG_SENSORS_K10TEMP=m
CONFIG_SP5100_TCO=m
CONFIG_EDAC_AMD64=m
CONFIG_X86_MCE_AMD=y
# What the machine boots from, what it boots with, and what must keep loading:
# the disk and USB stack the systemd initrd asks for, the NIC, the panel's
# driver, the EC and sensors, the watchdog, and the module the undervolt writes
# through. A trim that takes one of these is a machine that does not come back.
CONFIG_SATA_AHCI=m
CONFIG_BLK_DEV_SD=m
CONFIG_USB_STORAGE=m
CONFIG_USB_XHCI_HCD=m
CONFIG_USB_EHCI_HCD=m
CONFIG_ZRAM=m
CONFIG_NF_TABLES=m
CONFIG_X86_MSR=m
CONFIG_KVM_AMD=m
CONFIG_WLAN=y
CONFIG_RFKILL=m
CONFIG_SND_HDA_INTEL=m
CONFIG_HP_BIOSCFG=m
CONFIG_HP_ACCEL=m
CONFIG_SENSORS_LIS3LV02D=m
CONFIG_SENSORS_LIS3_I2C=m
CONFIG_MISC_RTSX_PCI=m
CONFIG_MMC_REALTEK_PCI=m
CONFIG_I2C_PIIX4=m
